Name: AudioDuck
Author: xenside
Description: Per-app audio ducking: when one app plays (e.g. Discord), others get quieter. Each key is one rule, set up in its settings; tapping the key turns that rule off and on, and its colour shows whether the rule is off, listening or ducking right now. Runs while Stream Deck runs.

Actions.Name: Regola di ducking
Actions.Tooltip: One ducking rule per key: set it up in the key settings, tap to turn it off and on.
